title: Orthic native lifecycle qualification matrix
description: Producer-side matrix for O5 native lifecycle qualification. N-MAC and N-WIN execute every applicable case from identical source/contract/add-on digests and emit a receipt conforming to receipt.schema.json. Lifecycle/adversarial cases stage a fixture product manifest (whose serviceStart is the shipped executable lifecycle-fixture.mjs with a scenario) into the Hub product-scan directory, then LAUNCH THE HUB — the Hub supervises the fixture; the case observes the Hub-level outcome. The wrong-digest case is manifest-level (the Hub refuses launch before spawn, so no fixture scenario speaks the lifecycle channel). No fabricated Hub CLI flags (--select/--handoff) or nonexistent right-release rollback subcommand are referenced.

placeholders.description: Absolute path to the executable tests/native/lifecycle-fixture.mjs (Mac: shebang+chmod+x; Windows: a staged launcher). serviceStart[0]; digest-stamped into the fixture manifest's artifactDigest as sha256(serviceStart[0]).

Absolute path to a fixture product manifest N-MAC/N-WIN materialize from fixtures/fixture-product-manifest.template.json for a scenario, with <fixture-child>, <scenario>, <fixture-install-root> replaced and artifactDigest stamped from serviceStart[0]'s bytes. Staged into the Hub product-scan directory before launching the Hub.
The lifecycle-fixture.mjs --scenario value for the case (normal, degraded, incompatible-range, stale-fence, old-instance, rogue-endpoint, update-handoff).
Absolute path to the staged fixture install root (owner-only), used as the manifest installRoot and icon base.
Process id of the running Hub, resolved by N-MAC/N-WIN at run time.
Process id of a supervised product child, resolved at run time.
Absolute path to a previously signed installer restored from the release archive for rollback (re-install of the prior pinned bytes).
Absolute path to a signed update manifest for the replacement version, staged into the Hub update channel.

cases.summary: Fresh install launches the Hub and shows onboarding; no product runtime does work before activation.

steps.assert: onboarding picker visible; census live==0 product children
onboarding picker visible; census live==0 product children

cases.summary: Only a Cortex product manifest present => exactly one tab; Membrane absent so its runtime never spawns.

steps.assert: one tab (cortex); census live==0 membrane children
one tab (cortex); census live==0 membrane children

cases.summary: Both Cortex and Membrane manifests present => exactly two tabs; Membrane implies Cortex.

steps.assert: two tabs (cortex, membrane); membrane tab non-deselectable
two tabs (cortex, membrane); membrane tab non-deselectable

cases.summary: If only a Membrane manifest is present the Hub still surfaces Cortex (Membrane implies Cortex) and never runs Membrane alone.

steps.assert: cortex auto-present and non-deselectable; membrane not run alone
cortex auto-present and non-deselectable; membrane not run alone

cases.summary: A product run directly (no Hub, no hello on stdin) declares ownerMode=headless, emits zero bytes, never self-registers, and never attaches to a Hub lease. The fixture's idle guard exits 0 within 2s without writing any register.

steps.assert: ownerMode=headless; stdout zero bytes; exit 0; census live==0 Hub-owned children
ownerMode=headless; stdout zero bytes; exit 0; census live==0 Hub-owned children

cases.summary: Stage the normal-scenario fixture manifest, launch the Hub; the supervised fixture registers a loopback endpoint + capability and reaches ready.

steps.assert: product status ready; capability non-empty; endpoint 127.0.0.1
product status ready; capability non-empty; endpoint 127.0.0.1

cases.summary: Stage the degraded-scenario fixture manifest, launch the Hub; the fixture registers state=degraded and the Hub surfaces worst-state degraded without fabricating healthy.

steps.assert: degraded tab + degraded tray severity; census live bounded; no healthy promotion
degraded tab + degraded tray severity; census live bounded; no healthy promotion

cases.summary: Stage the incompatible-range-scenario fixture manifest, launch the Hub; the fixture registers state=incompatible and the Hub renders typed incompatible, never guessing launch.

steps.assert: tab renders incompatible; census live==0 launched children
tab renders incompatible; census live==0 launched children

cases.summary: Quitting the Hub stops every product child and leaves zero orphan descendants.

steps.assert: zero orphan children; census live==0
zero orphan children; census live==0

cases.summary: Hub quit runs the declared stop argv, drains within bound, and terminates the full child tree.

steps.assert: declared stop argv honoured; full tree reaped; census live==0
declared stop argv honoured; full tree reaped; census live==0

cases.summary: A crashed product child is restarted with capped backoff then escalates to crash-loop after the threshold.

steps.assert: restart within backoff; crash_loop state after threshold; census live bounded
restart within backoff; crash_loop state after threshold; census live bounded

cases.summary: Hub restart re-spawns active products with fresh monotonic fences and exactly one owner per product.

steps.assert: one owner per product; fence strictly greater than previous; census live bounded
one owner per product; fence strictly greater than previous; census live bounded

cases.summary: Loss of the Hub owner (parent death) drains the child within bound and the child exits.

steps.assert: child observes EOF, drains, exits; census live==0
child observes EOF, drains, exits; census live==0

cases.summary: Stage the update-handoff-scenario fixture manifest, launch the Hub, then stage a newer signed update manifest into the Hub update channel; the Hub sends the lifecycle update_handoff command, the old child drains, and the replacement owns the fence.

steps.assert: old child acks update_handoff and drains; new child owns fence; census live bounded
old child acks update_handoff and drains; new child owns fence; census live bounded

cases.summary: Rollback restores the previous installed bytes by re-running the prior signed installer (re-install of the prior pinned artifact), then re-supervises the prior version. There is no right-release rollback subcommand.

steps.assert: previous installed bytes restored; prior version supervised; census live bounded
previous installed bytes restored; prior version supervised; census live bounded

cases.summary: Uninstall leaves zero orphan children, descendants, listeners, or stale fence state. Mac reaps children then removes the bundle + Hub state dir (Orthic ships no mac uninstall script). Windows invokes the registered NSIS UninstallString silently.

steps.assert: zero orphan descendants; products dir absent; no stale fence state
zero orphan descendants; products dir absent; no stale fence state

cases.summary: After off/quit/update/rollback/uninstall the census reports zero live children and zero descendants.

steps.assert: census.live==0 && census.descendants==0
census.live==0 && census.descendants==0

cases.summary: Stage the stale-fence-scenario fixture manifest, launch the Hub; the fixture registers with a stale fence and is rejected fail-closed.

steps.assert: registration rejected: stale_fence; census live==0 adopted children
registration rejected: stale_fence; census live==0 adopted children

cases.summary: Stage the old-instance-scenario fixture manifest, launch the Hub; the fixture's second register (old instance) cannot adopt the current lease.

steps.assert: old child rejected: stale_fence; current owner retained
old child rejected: stale_fence; current owner retained

cases.summary: Manifest-level digest mismatch. Stage a fixture product manifest whose artifactDigest does not match the staged serviceStart[0] bytes, launch the Hub; the Hub refuses launch before spawn (artifact_digest_mismatch), so the fixture never speaks the lifecycle channel. The fixture has no wrong-digest scenario because the digest is checked before the child runs.

steps.assert: launch refused: artifact_digest_mismatch; census live==0 spawned children; no lifecycle register emitted
launch refused: artifact_digest_mismatch; census live==0 spawned children; no lifecycle register emitted

cases.summary: Stage a fixture manifest whose hubCompatRange excludes the Hub version, launch the Hub; the Hub refuses launch typed (manifest_hub_range_incompatible).

steps.assert: tab incompatible: manifest_hub_range_incompatible; census live==0 launched children
tab incompatible: manifest_hub_range_incompatible; census live==0 launched children

cases.summary: Stage the rogue-endpoint-scenario fixture manifest, launch the Hub; the fixture registers a non-loopback endpoint and is rejected.

steps.assert: registration rejected: endpoint_not_loopback; census live==0 adopted children
registration rejected: endpoint_not_loopback; census live==0 adopted children
